rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: Summer Snow (floribunda, Perkins, 1938)
rows.Origin: Discovered by Charles H. Perkins (United States, 1938).
rows.Bloom: White. Mild fragrance. Small, semi-double to double bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: susceptible to Mildew. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Patents: United States - Patent No: PP 416 on 13 Aug 1940 VIEW USPTO PATENT
rows.Notes: According to Ludwigs Roses this rose is thornless. It is also one of the few times that a bush rose sported from a climber, usually it's th eother way around.
